name: cspell-sync
description: Synchronize project cSpell.words with global cSpell.userWords — automatically, bidirectionally, across all your projects.

commands.title: cSpell Sync: Sync Words from Projects to Global Dictionary
cSpell Sync: Sync Words from Global Dictionary to Projects
cSpell Sync: Sync Words from Custom Dictionaries to Global Dictionary

cspell-sync.autoSyncOnStartup.description: Automatically sync cSpell words from project settings to global settings on startup.

cspell-sync.initialSyncDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before running initial sync on startup.

cspell-sync.combinedFileWaitTime.description: Time in milliseconds to wait before checking combined.txt file after detection.

cspell-sync.logToOutputChannel.description: Log detailed sync operations to output channel.

cspell-sync.showNotifications.description: Show notifications when words are synced.

cspell-sync.syncProjectSettings.description: Sync words from project settings.json (cSpell.words) to global dictionary.

cspell-sync.syncCombinedTxt.description: Sync words from combined.txt files to global dictionary.

cspell-sync.syncCustomDictionaries.description: Sync words from custom dictionaries to global dictionary.

cspell-sync.syncLanguageSettings.description: Sync words from language-specific settings to global dictionary.

cspell-sync.enableBidirectionalSync.description: Enable syncing words from global dictionary back to project settings.

cspell-sync.bidirectionalSyncMode.description: How to sync words from global dictionary to project: 'shortcut' (only via keyboard shortcut), 'automatic' (also sync when global dictionary changes), or 'disabled'.

enabled.description: Enable syncing to project level settings (cSpell.words in .vscode/settings.json)

target.description: Which project-level cSpell setting to sync words to

cspell-sync.projectLevelSync.description: Settings for syncing to project level settings

enabled.description: Enable syncing words to a custom dictionary file

dictionaryName.description: Name of the custom dictionary to sync to (must be defined in cSpell.customDictionaries)

cspell-sync.customDictionarySync.description: Settings for syncing to existing custom dictionaries

target.description: Which workspace-level cSpell setting to sync words to

cspell-sync.workspaceSync.description: Settings for syncing to workspace-level settings

enabled.description: Enable creating/syncing to a new dictionary file

format.description: Format for the new dictionary file

cspell-sync.newDictionarySync.description: Settings for creating and syncing to a new dictionary

cspell-sync.customToGlobalSync.description: Sync words from custom dictionaries to global dictionary when running project-to-global sync

scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:vsce && npm run publish:ovsx
